display_long_description:
Take control of passenger buses and conquer demanding routes in Offroad Bus VR: Driving Simulator. Drive across mountain roads, muddy trails, rocky paths, narrow bridges, river crossings, and steep hills in VR.

Each mission tests your precision and control. Pick up passengers, follow checkpoints, manage sharp turns, climb difficult slopes, and reach every destination safely. Heavy buses react differently across rough terrain, so careful steering, smooth braking, and balanced speed are essential.

Experience cockpit driving with responsive controls, realistic handling, mirrors, obstacles, and changing conditions. Rain, fog, snow, and different times of day make familiar roads more difficult and unpredictable. Navigate slippery surfaces, low-visibility sections, unstable bridges, tight mountain passes, and dangerous drops where one mistake can end the trip.

Unlock additional buses as you progress, each with its own size, speed, suspension, and handling style. Improve performance, complete tougher missions, and master routes built to test your skill.

Enjoy first-person VR bus driving, challenging passenger transport missions, realistic steering and braking, heavy-vehicle physics, dynamic weather, day-to-night conditions, multiple unlockable buses, and progressive single-player gameplay across mountains, forests, mud, rocks, bridges, and rivers.

Start the engine, grip the wheel, and prove you can master the toughest off-road bus routes in immersive virtual reality.
